title: Fight Club - The Recall Coordinator's Formula
summary: A two-minute clip from the film Fight Club in which the narrator, a former recall coordinator, explains the formula companies use to decide whether a recall costs more than paying out settlements.
why: Cited whenever a thread shows a company weighing cost against safety or customer harm.

quote.text: I'm reminded of the delightful opening scene of "Fight Club" where the narrator explains that his job is to apply "The Formula".
